opening.argument: The video shows a Blogger workflow: the speaker directs viewers to the platform, describes creating an account and explains how to confirm publication of a post. The visible dashboard offers theme choices and an Apply control, while another frame shows a post editor with a title entered. Those are concrete steps in a blogging tutorial, not evidence of a request for payment, credentials or private data. The discussion of earning money and an income figure is qualified by the description, which says results are not typical and earnings are not guaranteed. A potentially inaccurate copyright-related statement does not, on its own, establish a deceptive mechanism.
